selection: First-5%-crossing configurations: 15 compact and 15 dispersed; 64 fresh continuations per configuration and treatment; 5760 total. Original, fixed-strategy-equilibrium adapted, and periodic resource translation (17,12); reference physical parameters. Average conditional mean increment / Delta and unbiased within-configuration increment variance / Delta at Delta=1,2,5,10,20 MCS. Count-based rates in defectors/MCS and defectors^2/MCS, not probabilities; signed drift is retained and variance-rate axes start at zero. Lines join only these windows, with no fitted scaling law. Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap intervals are retained in the statistics file, not drawn; 10000 whole-configuration resamples; all arms and windows of a configuration remain paired; seed 20261008. These are finite-MCS empirical moments, not frozen first-visit identities.
